verdict.rationale: Braintrust evals run functions over entire datasets in one call (braintrust-gh-1/2, braintrust-docs-27/31), the API and CLI support bulk creation/management of projects, experiments, datasets, and log syncing (braintrust-docs-34,35,41), and Patterns/Loop scan the entire trace backlog for issues at scale (braintrust-docs-7,20). Missing for 10: explicit UI evidence of selecting/bulk-editing multiple existing records (e.g., bulk tag/delete) and independent hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows at scale.
